_comment: Accepted Cisco skill-scanner findings, each read by a reviewer. Remove an entry to re-evaluate it.

accepted.title: Unpinned dependency
accepted.reason: Reviewed 2026-09-10: references to the skill's own reference files (AE1), example URLs api.example.com (E1), 'access tokens' and 'call any tools' phrases in MCP best-practice prose (PE3, EA1), a model name in an evaluation script option (EA5), unpinned anthropic and mcp requirements (SC1, SC4; Cisco MEDIUM). webapp-testing's with_server.py runs the dev-server command it is given with shell=True (TM1, AST4; Cisco HIGH). In Bob the agent writes that command, so it must come from the project's own scripts and be shown to the user first, as the bob-essentials security-defaults rule requires; the tests target localhost only. Corrected 2026-09-11.
